link_rule_original:
rule CXX_EXECUTABLE_LINKER__yosys_MinSizeRel
  command = C:\WINDOWS\system32\cmd.exe /C "$PRE_LINK && D:\fpga-v14-work\msys64\ucrt64\bin\g++.exe $FLAGS $LINK_FLAGS @$RSP_FILE -o $TARGET_FILE -Wl,--out-implib,$TARGET_IMPLIB -Wl,--major-image-version,0,--minor-image-version,0 && $POST_BUILD"
  description = Linking CXX executable $TARGET_FILE
  rspfile = $RSP_FILE
  rspfile_content = $in $LINK_PATH $LINK_LIBRARIES
  restat = $RESTAT

version_metadata.policy: Reuse original real 0.69 commit-dirty version object and its v25 build timestamp; incremental timestamp recorded separately.

new_id_policy: Same pmux_competition_opt.cc basename; upstream Windows create_id_prefix strips directory; v26 source line numbers retained without remapping.
headers_policy: Original immutable parent source and generated include directories, unchanged arguments.
